name: Mercedes-Benz

logo.alt: The Mercedes-Benz three-pointed star, rendered in chrome, inside a circular ring

credit.author: Khaled

credit.licenseNote: Displayed unmodified to identify this manufacturer's own vehicles, editorially and without any suggestion of endorsement or affiliation. Commons licenses the vector rendering itself CC BY-SA 4.0, but the star device it depicts is a Mercedes-Benz trademark; the basis for display here is trademark nominative use, not the copyright licence on the rendering (SPEC.md §10, §11.2).

accentColorNote: Sampled from the single most frequently used fill colour (#71777a, used 947 times) in the badge's own SVG source — the artwork is a shaded chrome rendering rather than a flat brand colour, so no one hex is 'the' logo colour; this is the dominant grey among its many gradient stops. Mercedes-Benz publishes no public flat brand-colour specification for the star.
